data.name: PageDescription
data.value: The single list of the company's physical places. Stock, warehouse, purchasing and production read from this list.

data.name: CompanySelectHint
data.value: Select the company whose locations you want to see. Nothing is shown until a company is selected.

data.name: CompanyUnavailable
data.value: The company list could not be loaded, so no location is shown. Ask your administrator for permission to view companies, or try again later.

data.name: ModeExternal
data.value: Stock in an external system, tracked via integration

data.name: ParentPlaceholder
data.value: Search a parent by code or name

data.name: HintCode
data.value: Unique in this company. It can be changed later: stock keeps pointing to the same location.

data.name: HintTypeFixed
data.value: The type cannot be changed. If it is wrong, archive the record and create a new one.

data.name: HintZoneOptional
data.value: A bin can also sit directly under a storage location, without a zone.

data.name: HintCompany
data.value: The location belongs to the selected company; locations below inherit it. The company cannot be changed.

data.name: OrgUnitsUnavailable
data.value: The organizational unit list could not be read. You can leave the field empty and save.

data.name: ValidationCodeFormat
data.value: Use 1–40 characters: letters, digits and . _ / - only.

data.name: ValidationCostCenterFormat
data.value: Use 1–40 characters: letters, digits and . _ - only.

data.name: ConfirmActivateText
data.value: {0} will be active again and can be selected on stock forms.

data.name: ConfirmDeactivateText
data.value: {0} will be deactivated. Inactive locations cannot be selected on stock forms.

data.name: ConfirmArchiveText
data.value: {0} will be archived. This cannot be undone: an archived location cannot be reactivated or changed. It is not deleted and stays visible in past movements.

data.name: BulkSkipped
data.value: {0} codes already exist and will be skipped.

data.name: ErrCodeTaken
data.value: This code is already used in this company. Choose another code.

data.name: ErrLevelInvalid
data.value: This type cannot sit under the chosen parent (site → warehouse → storage location → zone → bin; a bin may also sit under a storage location).

data.name: ErrParentInactive
data.value: The parent is not active. Activate the parent first.

data.name: ErrMoveIntoSubtree
data.value: A location cannot be moved under itself or under one of its own children.

data.name: ErrHasStock
data.value: This location (or one below it) holds stock, so the change is not possible. Transfer the stock first. Nothing was changed.

data.name: ErrHasActiveChildren
data.value: This location has active child locations. Deactivate them first.

data.name: ErrArchived
data.value: The location is archived and cannot be changed (nor can anything be added under it).

data.name: ErrLocationConflict
data.value: Someone else saved this location after you opened it. Reload it and make your change again.

data.name: ErrBulkLimit
data.value: At most 1000 bins can be created at once. Narrow the ranges.

data.name: ErrUnknownLocation
data.value: The location was not found in this company. Reload the page.

data.name: ErrOrgUnitInvalid
data.value: This organizational unit is not an active unit of this company. Choose another one or leave the field empty.

data.name: ErrOrgUnitDirectoryUnavailable
data.value: The organizational unit could not be checked right now, so nothing was saved. Try again, or leave the field empty and save.

data.name: ErrKeyReused
data.value: This action was already submitted with other values. Close the dialog and start again.

data.name: ErrInvalidRequest
data.value: The request could not be processed because a value is not valid. Check the fields and try again.

data.name: ErrCrossLegalEntity
data.value: This record belongs to another company. Switch to that company or ask your administrator for access.

data.name: ErrCompanyCheckUnavailable
data.value: The selected company cannot be confirmed right now, so no change was made. Try again in a moment.

data.name: ErrSelectCompany
data.value: Select a company first. Nothing was read or changed.

data.name: ErrNoPermission
data.value: You do not have access to this action. Ask your administrator for the location permissions you need.

data.name: ErrSessionExpired
data.value: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

data.name: ErrServiceUnavailable
data.value: The location service cannot be reached right now. No change was made; try again in a moment.

data.name: ErrConflict
data.value: The data changed while you were working. Reload and try again.

data.name: ErrGeneric
data.value: Something went wrong and no change was made. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support.
